messages:
maya: Vendor finished assessment for staging at 11:42 PT. They uploaded initial report and a set of findings (PT-2143, PT-2144). Need to confirm access windows, evidence packaging, and temporary RBAC before we hand over remediation tickets.

alex: Thanks. Can we confirm the list of accounts they used? We should create a temp role instead of adding to existing groups.

jonathan: Agreed. I propose role `pt_assessor_readonly` scoped to: kms:Decrypt (only for key alias/pt/assess), s3:GetObject for s3://pt-evidence/redwood/2026-03-20, and logs:FilterLogEvents on the audit log bucket. Role TTL 72h.

maya: That seems right. Also require MFA + session tag `assessor=true` so we can filter later. Can ops spawn it with an expiration and record it in the evidence manifest?

ops-oncall: I can create the role and an STS session. Will need the vendor's principal ARN and an approved access window. When do they need it?

maya: Tentative retest window is Tue 2026-03-24 09:00-12:00 PT. Please create role by Mon EOD and post creds as presigned session link to the evidence bucket. Use presigned expirations of 6 hours max.

samir: For evidence packaging: vendor asked to upload logs and screenshots. We prefer a presigned S3 path `s3://pt-evidence/redwood/2026-03-20/vendor-uploads/`. Please enforce object ACL=private and server-side encryption with KMS key `alias/pt/assess`.

alex: I'll update the temporary KMS key policy to allow `kms:Encrypt`, `kms:Decrypt` for the role and the vendor principal, but deny key deletion. Also add a CloudTrail event selector for KMS events for that key.

jonathan: Make sure we capture `Decrypt` events. To query later, use CloudTrail Lake or CloudWatch Logs filter. Example CW Logs Insights query:

```
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters
| filter eventName = "Decrypt" and requestParameters.keyId like "*pt/assess*"
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50
```

maya: Perfect. Also we need to snapshot current key rotation state and a KMS alias policy export. Put them in the evidence path.

securitybot: [automated] PT ticket PT-2143: high - network exposure. Status created by vendor. Assigned to eng-runtime.

samir: For RBAC change tracking, we should add an audit tag to the role creation PR and reference PT-2143. Then merge with admin approval and link the PR in the evidence manifest.

ops-oncall: Created role `pt_assessor_readonly` (ARN: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/pt_assessor_readonly). STS sessions can be issued via `assume-role` with MFA. I pushed the role policy and attached key policy changes. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/iam/home?region=us-west-2#/roles/pt_assessor_readonly

alex: Confirmed. I also created a CloudTrail log group filter and an S3 Lifecycle that expires vendor uploads after 90 days (retain manifest to evidence/retention-manifest.json).

maya: Next: remediation tracker. Please file bugs in JIRA under project PT with labels `pen-test` and `staging`. I'll consolidate and turn high/medium into concrete work-items. Current criticals: PT-2143 (network exposure), PT-2144 (exposed creds). Assign eng-runtime and eng-infra leads.

jonathan: For PT-2144 (exposed creds) — temporary mitigation we applied: rotated prod-ish service account keys, invalidated old tokens, and updated secret references in vault. Need to document KMS decrypt timeline for verification during retest.

samir: I'll prepare a short runbook for the retest: steps to enable role, confirm audit logging, provide presigned link, and confirm evidence uploaded. Put runbook at `docs/pt/retest-runbook.md` in the repo.

maya: Two open asks: 1) ops to produce signed presigned URLs and post manifest by Mon EOD. 2) eng leads to attach remediation PRs to Jira tickets by Mon EOD.

ops-oncall: Will do. I'll also make sure the presigned links expire and that CloudTrail alerts for KMS Decrypt are enabled for the window.

alex: After retest, we must rotate the KMS key and remove role `pt_assessor_readonly`. Also audit the CloudTrail logs for any unexplained Decrypts. Plan: rotate within 24h of successful retest; ops to coordinate.

maya: Great. I'll send the vendor the retest window and required deliverables. Thanks all :thumbsup:

securitybot: [automated] Reminder scheduled for 2026-03-23 17:00 UTC to validate role creation and evidence path.

jonathan: Quick question — do we allow vendor to request ephemeral console access (fed login) or only programmatic STS? My preference is programmatic only.

maya: Programmatic only. No console access.

samir: Copy. I'll add that to the runbook.

maya: Closing the loop: I'll post final checklist in this thread after Mon EOD. If anything blocks role creation ping me or ops-oncall. Thank you.
